notes.title: Abandonment Achievement Fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the related achievement would not unlock after 30 days of abandonment. It can now also be unlocked if you had quit Happy while he was sleeping.

notes.title: Game translation into 9 new languages
notes.content:
The game has now been translated into 9 new languages, which are included below :
- Italian
- Spanish
- German
- Portuguese
- Simplified Chinese
- Japanese
- Korean
- Russian
- Polish

I hope this makes the game more accessible. Please note that languages outside the EU do not have supported fonts, only the Cyrillic alphabet is currently supported.

notes.title: 🐱 Meow meow, it's release time !
notes.content:
Happy can't wait to see you again so you can take good care of him !
